ceu: ✦ The trine between Mercury and Pluto

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
From {H:1820239274000}, the Moon moves into {S:8} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.
